name: HX711 Load Cell Amplifier
description: 24-bit ADC and amplifier for Wheatstone bridge load cells. Supports 10 SPS / 80 SPS data rate. Used for bin weight, industrial scales, and force measurement.

signals.name: weight_kg
signals.description: Measured weight after tare and calibration

firmwareHint: Use HX711 library by bogde. Call tare() on boot with no load. Calibrate with known weight: calibrationFactor = raw / knownWeightKg.
